clean.tl: Once (they) sent a child to the water.

clean.tx: ečeži adisgx, [xoxra bepšwildær axa æt[i]dagriwx], eǯære lepane xoxra dirildærs i let'wra at'wrex ečeču
clean.tl: If small children from the household have died they set there little loaves of bread consecrated to them, and light a candle.
